episodes.synopsis: Shinjiro agrees to help test out and develop a new suit better adapted to his changing powers — and he finds himself using it much sooner than planned.
episodes.title: The Sign of a New Awakening

episodes.synopsis: He can't remember what he did, but Shinjiro's forbidden from wearing his suit for a while. His father can't help but feel that there's an Ultraman curse.
episodes.title: The Curse of Ultraman

episodes.synopsis: Determined to do something, Shinjiro heads out to get his revenge. But then once again, he wakes up with no memory of what happened.
episodes.title: The Choice of a Hero

episodes.synopsis: Public sentiment has turned completely against Ultraman. Then suddenly, Mephisto hijacks the airwaves to deliver a message directly to the people.
episodes.title: No One to Trust

episodes.synopsis: Ide sends Taro and Moroboshi out to search for Shinjiro, who remains on the run, confused by everything that's been happening to him.
episodes.title: Hide and Seek

episodes.synopsis: Back in his hideout, Daisuke Arashi tells Shinjiro about his father's past, and they try to narrow down who Mephisto's next target might be.
episodes.title: A Warrior's Return

episodes.synopsis: After getting devastating news, Rena meets with Seiji Hokuto. Shinjiro talks to Daisuke about the strange dreams he's been having about Zetton.
episodes.title: The Fourth Successor

episodes.synopsis: Rena can't understand what just happened to her, so Seiji brings her to meet the alien who raised him. Taro finally finds Shinjiro.
episodes.title: TARO vs ULTRAMAN

episodes.synopsis: Jack shows up, surprising Taro and Shinjiro. Rena seeks some answers about where her powers come from. The SSSP gets raided by the police.
episodes.title: Time of Awakening

episodes.synopsis: The fight against Mephisto only strengthens the anti-Ultraman sentiment. Moroboshi and Shinjiro try to break into the heavily guarded SSSP headquarters.
episodes.title: The Disaster

episodes.synopsis: Shinjiro and Rena reveal some secrets to each other. Joined by his friends, Ultraman faces a powerful enemy from the past.
episodes.title: A Nightmare Come True

episodes.synopsis: As Shinjiro struggles in his own fight, his friends put everything they can into defeating Zetton. A new chapter begins for the SSSP.
episodes.title: Finale
